question: Builders of which of the following temples had constructed a 4 km long incline for placing 90 tonnes of stone on top of the tallest shikhara amongst temples of its time?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Rajarajeshvara Temple.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rajarajeshvara temple **at Thanjavur had the **highest shikhara** between temples of its time.
 
• Constructing it was not easy as there were no cranes in those days and the **90 tonne stone** for the top of the shikhara was **too weighty to lift physically.**
 
• So architects constructed an inclined plane to the **top of the temple**, put down the boulder on rollers and rolled it all the way to the top. 
 
• The path began more than **four kilometres** away so that it would not be too steep. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kandariya Mahadeva Temple** is the tallest, the largest and the most impressive in the Khajuraho complex.
 
• The **Sun Temple's** geometrical patterns and carved wheels used to work as sun dials.​ 
 
• **Gangadikondha temple** is a living history of the** Cholas **in stone from the time of **Rajendra-I** and a attractive gallery of Chola art and architecture.

73
